args: set -euo pipefail; t=$(mktemp -d); git clone -q https://github.com/bradheitmann/model-tier-drop "$t/r"; cd "$t/r"; cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace; cargo build --manifest-path crates/worker/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown; pnpm --dir adapters/dsh install; pnpm --dir adapters/dsh check; gitleaks detect --redact --source .
set -euo pipefail; gh repo view bradheitmann/model-tier-drop --json visibility,licenseInfo | jq -e '.visibility == "PUBLIC" and .licenseInfo.name == "Apache License 2.0"'

set -euo pipefail; u=$(grep -oE 'https://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+/mcp' README.md | head -n 1); test -n "$u"; curl -s -X POST "$u" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"qa","version":"0"}}}' | jq -e '.result.serverInfo.name == "model-tier-drop"'

evidence_required: Live initialize response from the README URL.
objective: Independently clone the public repository with no prior context, follow the README, run the CI commands and the walkthrough, and confirm licence, visibility and the live MCP URL.

outputs.purpose: QA verdict for S-09 from a fresh public clone.

risk_controls: Run in a separate QA context that never implemented the slice; do not edit implementation files; a verdict is accept or reject with the failing check and defect list.
QA uses only the public clone and the README; no prior context.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's private organisation name (search pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden owner-framing phrase (search pattern needs[ ]you) into any file; plain, specific prose.
rollback: Delete qa/V-09 and the temporary clone; the published repository is unchanged.
steps: Clone https://github.com/bradheitmann/model-tier-drop into a temporary directory with no prior context.
Follow the README top to bottom.
Run the CI commands and the walkthrough.
Confirm the live MCP URL in the README answers initialize.
